name: knee-to-elbow-dumbbell-external-rotation
instructions:
1. Assume a seated position on a flat bench with one leg bent and your elbow on your knee while holding a dumbbell.
2. Keep the elbow directly on your knee and externally rotate at the shoulder.
3. Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
